title: CO2 Transport and Storage Availability Webinar
summary: Free virtual IEAGHG webinar on 24 November 2026 (13:00–14:00) presenting a study by TNO with SINTEF and SCCS on designing CO2 transport and storage networks for high availability and limited downtime for emitters. The study estimates realistic operational availability rates for pipeline transport and for storage in saline aquifers and depleted fields. Speakers include Ragnhild Skagestad (SINTEF), Filip Neele and Wouter Janssen (TNO) and Navraj Singh Ghaleigh (University of Edinburgh).
why_it_matters: Availability and downtime figures for pipelines and storage sites are direct inputs for redundancy, buffer storage and reliability constraints in CCS network-optimisation models.
